import { useEffect, useState } from 'react' import Layout from '../../components/Layout.jsx' import { Link } from 'react-router-dom' import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext' import api from '../../api/axios.js' export default function TeacherDashboard() { const { user } = useAuth() const [periodCount, setPeriodCount] = useState(null) useEffect(() => { api.get('/timetable/my/teacher') .then(res => setPeriodCount(res.data.length)) .catch(() => setPeriodCount(null)) }, []) return (

Welcome, {user?.name || 'Teacher'}

{periodCount === null ? 'Loading your schedule...' : `You have ${periodCount} period${periodCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} scheduled this week.`}

📅

My Timetable

 ) }
